func TestPromotionCIImageImportedSignedVerifiedAndReceipted(t *testing.T) {
	f := newPromotion(t)
	successful(t, f.promote(nil, nil, f.realArgs()...))
	equal(t, f.commands(), []string{"verify-binary", "verify-image-production", "image-candidate", "sign-image", "verify-image"})
	calls := f.calls()
	equal(t, flagValue(t, calls[2], "--image-ocid"), importedOCID)
	equal(t, flagValue(t, calls[2], "--base-image-ocid"), "ocid1.image.oc1.sa-saopaulo-1.base")
	equal(t, flagValue(t, calls[2], "--kernel-release"), "6.8.0-142-generic")
	equal(t, flagValue(t, calls[3], "--signing-key"), filepath.Join(f.trust, "leaf.pem"))
	for _, call := range calls[3:] {
		equal(t, flagValue(t, call, "--delegation"), filepath.Join(f.trust, "image-delegation.json"))
	}
	for _, call := range [][]string{calls[0], calls[2]} {
		equal(t, flagValue(t, call, "--delegation"), filepath.Join(f.trust, "delegation.json"))
	}
	f.imported(1)
	r := f.receipt()
	equal(t, r["dry_run"], false)
	imp := r["oci_import"].(map[string]any)
	equal(t, imp["image_id"], importedOCID)
	equal(t, imp["shapes"], []any{"VM.Standard.A1.Flex"})
	image := r["image"].(map[string]any)
	equal(t, image["sha256"], digest(f.image))
	equal(t, image["provenance"].(map[string]any)["workflow_run_head_sha"], strings.Repeat("b", 40))
	equal(t, image["provenance"].(map[string]any)["release_tag"], imageTag)
	equal(t, r["image_receipt"].(map[string]any)["image_ocid"], importedOCID)
	equal(t, r["tools"].(map[string]any)["gh"].(map[string]any)["sha256"], digest(read(t, f.gh)))
	equal(t, r["outcome"], "promotion complete")
}

[Unit]
Description=NetBird private management network and SSH
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
# Cell servers reach NetBird only through the gateway /32 on TCP 443 and UDP
# 3478, with no internet route, so ICE to operators or the routing peer can
# never succeed. Skip ICE and use the relay at once (NetBird 0.79 reads
# NB_FORCE_RELAY=true in the daemon). Lazy connections (NB_LAZY_CONN, the
# replacement for the inert --enable-lazy-connection flag) open a tunnel only
# when an operator connects. Intra-region cluster traffic uses VCN private IPs
# and never NetBird. The enrollment CLI runs with a scrubbed environment.
Environment=NB_FORCE_RELAY=true
Environment=NB_LAZY_CONN=on
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/netbird service run --config /var/lib/netbird/config.json --log-file console
Restart=always
RestartSec=10s
TimeoutStopSec=30s
StateDirectory=netbird
StateDirectoryMode=0700
# The daemon serves NetBird SSH. Like ssh.service it stays unconfined: login
# and su sessions need root privileges, PAM, setuid helpers and the full
# filesystem. A restart issued from a session must not kill that command.
KillMode=process
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=Join the TerraScale NetBird management network
# Instance-principal federation, Vault and the manager's TLS need a synced
# clock; the image bounds systemd-time-wait-sync with a drop-in.
Wants=network-online.target netbird.service systemd-time-wait-sync.service
After=network-online.target netbird.service systemd-time-wait-sync.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/netbird.json
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator netbird-enroll --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/netbird.json
Restart=on-failure
# Enrollment waits for the daemon socket and retries transient Vault errors
# itself, so a unit restart is the rare fallback and need not idle long.
RestartSec=5s
TimeoutStartSec=180s
UMask=0077
UnsetEnvironment=OCI_GO_SDK_DEBUG OCI_METADATA_BASE_URL OCI_SDK_AUTH_CLIENT_REGION_URL OCI_DEFAULT_CERTS_PATH OCI_DEFAULT_CLIENT_CERTS_PATH OCI_DEFAULT_CLIENT_CERTS_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
RuntimeDirectory=terrascale-netbird
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
StateDirectory=netbird
StateDirectoryMode=0700
StandardError=journal+console
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE CAP_CHOWN
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectSystem=strict
# The public management endpoint pin updates /etc/hosts by atomic rename.
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/netbird /run/terrascale-netbird /etc
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
LockPersonality=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=TerraScale Orchestrator regional controller
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
Requires=terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap.service
After=terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/controller.json
# A controller that keeps failing enters the failed state (start-limit-hit),
# visible to alerting and a rollout gate, instead of rejoining and leaving
# the cluster forever.
StartLimitIntervalSec=30min
StartLimitBurst=10

[Service]
# READY=1 follows the host controller's readiness; WATCHDOG=1 keepalives stop
# when the embedded broker or its in-process client is unusable.
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
# First cluster formation waits for peers and JetStream quorum.
TimeoutStartSec=20min
WatchdogSec=60s
User=terrascale-orchestrator
Group=terrascale-orchestrator
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator run --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/controller.json
# Keep the regional control plane schedulable under ordinary workload pressure.
# Image profile supplies this service's memory floor; target qualification reads it back.
CPUSchedulingPolicy=other
Nice=-20
CPUWeight=10000
IOWeight=10000
IOSchedulingClass=best-effort
IOSchedulingPriority=0
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
ManagedOOMPreference=omit
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
RestartSteps=6
RestartMaxDelaySec=5min
TimeoutStopSec=60s
KillSignal=SIGTERM
KillMode=control-group
LimitNOFILE=65536
LimitCORE=0
UMask=0077
StateDirectory=terrascale-orchestrator-controller
StateDirectoryMode=0700
WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator-controller
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
# The read-only kernel NTP health probe uses adjtimex(2); CAP_SYS_TIME is absent.
LockPersonality=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
SystemCallArchitectures=native
ProtectProc=invisible

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=TerraScale Orchestrator host runtime
Wants=network-online.target
Requires=terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
After=network-online.target terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
# Availability first: the restart backoff below reaches its 5min cap after
# seven starts (about 10 minutes), so at most about 17 starts fit in any hour
# and a loop at the capped backoff never reaches this burst; the host keeps
# retrying through a controller outage of any length. The limit only fails a
# runtime that restarts faster than that backoff (for example after a manual
# reset-failed), and the host-setup timer starts a failed runtime again.
StartLimitIntervalSec=1h
StartLimitBurst=20

[Service]
# READY=1 once the host is connected to its regional cell. No WatchdogSec=:
# restarting this process stops every supervised TerraBase member.
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
TimeoutStartSec=3min
# Runs as root by default: User=root with NoNewPrivileges=yes would make
# systemd drop CAP_SETUID, which the native workload helper needs.
SupplementaryGroups=
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator host --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
# Protect the host manager without throttling the managed database when idle.
# MemoryMin/MemoryLow come from the image profile; the native runner copies
# those floors to the supervisor subgroup.
CPUSchedulingPolicy=other
Nice=-20
CPUWeight=10000
IOWeight=10000
IOSchedulingClass=best-effort
IOSchedulingPriority=0
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
ManagedOOMPreference=omit
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
RestartSteps=6
RestartMaxDelaySec=5min
TimeoutStopSec=90s
KillSignal=SIGTERM
KillMode=control-group
LimitNOFILE=65536
LimitCORE=0
UMask=0077
StateDirectory=terrascale-orchestrator-host
StateDirectoryMode=0755
Delegate=yes
DelegateSubgroup=supervisor
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_CHOWN CAP_KILL CAP_SETGID CAP_SETUID CAP_SETPCAP CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectSystem=strict
# A custom root needs a drop-in that resets this list before adding its exact path.
ReadWritePaths=-/srv/ts-managed
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=no
ProtectHostname=yes
# The read-only kernel NTP health probe uses adjtimex(2); CAP_SYS_TIME is absent.
LockPersonality=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6

udev.text:
# OCI consistent device paths for paravirtualized block volumes.
#
# OCI attaches each paravirtualized volume as one LUN of the instance's
# virtio-scsi controller, and the device path chosen at attach time names that
# LUN: /dev/oracleoci/oraclevda is LUN 1 (the boot volume), oraclevdb LUN 2, and
# so on to oraclevdaf, LUN 32. Oracle's platform images create these links; a
# custom image needs this rule. Only whole ORACLE BlockVolume disks on a PCI
# SCSI path are named, so iSCSI attachments never receive a paravirtualized
# name. Each link is a root-owned relative symlink to the kernel disk node.
ACTION=="remove", GOTO="terrascale_oci_device_paths_end"
SUBSYSTEM!="block", GOTO="terrascale_oci_device_paths_end"
ENV{DEVTYPE}!="disk", GOTO="terrascale_oci_device_paths_end"
KERNEL!="sd*", GOTO="terrascale_oci_device_paths_end"
SUBSYSTEMS=="scsi", ATTRS{vendor}=="ORACLE*", ATTRS{model}=="BlockVolume*", GOTO="terrascale_oci_block_volume"
GOTO="terrascale_oci_device_paths_end"

LABEL="terrascale_oci_block_volume"
IMPORT{builtin}="path_id"
ENV{ID_PATH}=="pci-*-scsi-0:0:0:1", SYMLINK+="oracleoci/oraclevda"
ENV{ID_PATH}=="pci-*-scsi-0:0:0:2", SYMLINK+="oracleoci/oraclevdb"

promotion_pipeline.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Transport only: final-image admission belongs to release verify-image-production.
set -euo pipefail
[[ $# == 5 && $1 =~ ^ci-[0-9a-f]{40}-run-[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$ &&
    $2 =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ && $3 =~ ^[A-Z]{3}$ && ($4 == arm64 || $4 == amd64) ]] || {
    echo "usage: $0 ci-SHA-run-ID IMAGE_SHA256 CELL ARCH EVIDENCE_DIR" >&2; exit 2;
}
tag=$1
image_sha256=$2
cell=$3
architecture=$4
directory=$5
mkdir -p "$directory/$cell/$architecture" "$directory/objects"
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
gh release view "$tag" --repo TerraScale/ts-orchestrator --json assets > "$work/assets.json"
fetch() {
    local name=$1 output=$2 limit=$3
    jq -e --arg name "$name" --argjson limit "$limit" \
        '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | length == 1 and all(.size > 0 and .size <= $limit)' \
        "$work/assets.json" >/dev/null || { echo "retained image evidence unavailable: $name" >&2; return 1; }
    gh release download "$tag" --repo TerraScale/ts-orchestrator --pattern "$name" --output "$output" >/dev/null
    [[ -f $output && ! -L $output && $(stat -c '%s' "$output") -le $limit ]]
}
prefix=image-production-$image_sha256-$cell-$architecture
target=$directory/$cell/$architecture
fetch "$prefix.json" "$work/production.json" 1064960
if jq -e --arg name "$prefix-delegation.json" 'any(.assets[]; .name == $name)' "$work/assets.json" >/dev/null; then
